# Intune Deployment Evidence

Customer-facing evidence for the first execution of the Intune telemetry script. Use the time selector to limit the analysis window. In the manual POC workflow, deployment latency includes script generation, signing, upload, assignment, and execution delay.

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| where isnotnull(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes)
| summarize Devices=dcount(AzureAdDeviceId), P50Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 50), 1), P95Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 95), 1), P99Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 99), 1), Within60Devices=countif(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes <= 60)
| extend Within60Percent=iff(Devices == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * Within60Devices / Devices, 1))
| project Metrics=bag_pack("Devices reached", todouble(Devices), "P50 (minutes)", P50Minutes, "P95 (minutes)", P95Minutes, "P99 (minutes)", P99Minutes, "Within 60 minutes (%)", Within60Percent)
| mv-expand kind=array Metrics
| project Metric=tostring(Metrics[0]), Value=todouble(Metrics[1])
content.title: Deployment latency summary

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| where isnotnull(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes)
| summarize Devices=count() by bin(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, 15m)
| order by FirstExecutionTimestampUtc asc
| serialize
| extend CumulativeDevices=row_cumsum(Devices)
| project FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, CumulativeDevices
content.title: Cumulative devices reached

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| where isnotnull(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes)
| extend LatencyBand=case(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 15, "Under 15 minutes", AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 30, "15-30 minutes", AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 60, "30-60 minutes", AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 120, "1-2 hours", AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 240, "2-4 hours", AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 480, "4-8 hours", "Over 8 hours"), SortOrder=case(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 15, 1, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 30, 2, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 60, 3, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 120, 4, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 240, 5, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes < 480, 6, 7)
| summarize Devices=count(), SortOrder=min(SortOrder) by LatencyBand
| order by SortOrder asc
| project LatencyBand, Devices
content.title: Device distribution by deployment latency

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| where isnotnull(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes)
| summarize P50Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 50), 1), P95Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 95), 1), P99Minutes=round(percentile(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, 99), 1) by bin(AssignmentTimestampUtc, 1d)
| order by AssignmentTimestampUtc asc
content.title: Daily deployment latency trend

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| where isnotnull(AssignmentToExecutionMinutes)
| extend BootAfterAssignment=LastBootTimeUtc > AssignmentTimestampUtc, MdmSyncAfterAssignment=LastKnownMDMSync >= AssignmentTimestampUtc
| extend LikelyCause=case(BootAfterAssignment and UptimeHours < 2, "Device was likely offline", MdmSyncAfterAssignment and EstimatedMDMCheckInCycles > 1, "Multiple MDM cycles before execution", not(MdmSyncAfterAssignment), "No local MDM activity after assignment", "Requires event-level review")
| summarize Devices=count() by LikelyCause
| order by Devices desc
content.title: Likely cause of delayed execution

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| summarize arg_min(FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, *) by AzureAdDeviceId
| project DeviceName, AzureAdDeviceId, AssignmentTimestampUtc, FirstExecutionTimestampUtc, AssignmentToExecutionMinutes, LastBootTimeUtc, UptimeHours, LastKnownMDMSync, EstimatedMDMCheckInCycles, MDMCheckInCycleMethod, MDMEventsTruncated, MDMCycleEventsTruncated, ScriptVersion, ErrorsTruncatedCount
| order by AssignmentToExecutionMinutes desc
content.title: Per-device deployment evidence

content.query:
IntuneDeploymentTelemetry_CL
| where array_length(Errors) > 0
| mv-expand Error=Errors
| summarize Devices=dcount(AzureAdDeviceId), Occurrences=count() by Operation=tostring(Error.Operation), Message=tostring(Error.Message)
| order by Occurrences desc
content.title: Endpoint collection errors

content.json:
## Interpretation notes

- Each visualization keeps only the first execution observed for each Entra device ID in the selected period.
- `EstimatedMDMCheckInCycles` is derived from bounded local event evidence and is not a service-side Intune counter.
- A missing device cannot appear in telemetry; compare the reached-device count with the intended Intune assignment population.
- Direct-ingestion POC data is endpoint asserted and demonstrates transport and timing, not strong device identity.
